```yaml
name: E2E Portals

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]

jobs:
  e2e-portals:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - name: Cache Cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-

      - name: Cache Cargo git
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-git-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-git-

      - name: Cache Cargo target
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-target-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-target-

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: tests/e2e/package-lock.json

      - name: Install frontend dependencies
        run: |
          cd tests/e2e
          npm ci

      - name: Build Rust binaries
        run: |
          cargo build --release --bin tavern
          cargo build --release --bin imixv2
          cargo build --release --bin socks5

      - name: Start Tavern server
        run: |
          mkdir -p logs
          ./target/release/tavern > logs/tavern.log 2>&1 &
          echo $! > tavern.pid
          # Wait for Tavern to be ready (adjust port if necessary, assuming default 8080 or similar)
          for i in {1..30}; do
            if curl -s http://localhost:8080/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Tavern is ready"
              break
            fi
            if [ $i -eq 30 ]; then
              echo "Tavern failed to start"
              cat logs/tavern.log
              exit 1
            fi
            sleep 2
          done

      - name: Start Imix agent
        run: |
          ./target/release/imixv2 > logs/imix.log 2>&1 &
          echo $! > imix.pid
          # Wait for Imix to be ready
          for i in {1..30}; do
            if curl -s http://localhost:8081/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Imix is ready"
              break
            fi
            if [ $i -eq 30 ]; then
              echo "Imix failed to start"
              cat logs/imix.log
              exit 1
            fi
            sleep 2
          done

      - name: Run Playwright E2E tests
        run: |
          cd tests/e2e
          npx playwright test portal.spec.ts --reporter=list

      - name: Retrieve Portal ID via GraphQL
        id: get_portal_id
        run: |
          # Assuming the Playwright test outputs the portal ID to a file or environment variable
          # If not, we query the API directly. Adjust the query and endpoint as needed.
          PORTAL_ID=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/graphql \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{"query": "{ portals { id } }"}' | jq -r '.data.portals[0].id')
          
          if [ -z "$PORTAL_ID" ] || [ "$PORTAL_ID" = "null" ]; then
            echo "Failed to retrieve Portal ID"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "portal_id=$PORTAL_ID" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Retrieved Portal ID: $PORTAL_ID"

      - name: Start SOCKS5 proxy
        run: |
          PORTAL_ID=${{ steps.get_portal_id.outputs.portal_id }}
          ./target/release/socks5 --portal-id $PORTAL_ID > logs/socks5.log 2>&1 &
          echo $! > socks5.pid
          sleep 5 # Allow proxy to initialize

      - name: Start mock HTTP server
        run: |
          # Create a simple mock server using Python or Node
          # Here we use a simple Python HTTP server serving a test file
          mkdir -p mock_server
          echo "Hello from E2E Test" > mock_server/test.txt
          python3 -m http.server 9999 --directory mock_server > logs/mock_server.log 2>&1 &
          echo $! > mock_server.pid
          sleep 2

      - name: Verify data integrity
        run: |
          # Generate a random file to transfer
          dd if=/dev/urandom of=transfer_test.bin bs=1024 count=100
          ORIGINAL_CHECKSUM=$(sha256sum transfer_test.bin | awk '{print $1}')
          
          # Transfer file through SOCKS5 proxy
          # Using curl with socks5 proxy
          curl -x socks5h://localhost:1080 http://localhost:9999/test.txt -o received_test.txt
          
          # Compare checksums
          RECEIVED_CHECKSUM=$(sha256sum received_test.txt | awk '{print $1}')
          
          if [ "$ORIGINAL_CHECKSUM" != "$RECEIVED_CHECKSUM" ]; then
            echo "Checksum mismatch!"
            echo "Original: $ORIGINAL_CHECKSUM"
            echo "Received: $RECEIVED_CHECKSUM"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "Data integrity verified successfully"

      - name: Cleanup processes
        if: always()
        run: |
          kill $(cat tavern.pid) 2>/dev/null || true
          kill $(cat imix.pid) 2>/dev/null || true
          kill $(cat socks5.pid) 2>/dev/null || true
          kill $(cat mock_server.pid) 2>/dev/null || true

      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-logs
          path: logs/
```
